reviews.text: Several messages left in vain... They never call you back! No respect for the customer.

After waiting for my anger to subside, I unfortunately cannot recommend this groomer. Rodolphe was careful, but his partner unfortunately butchered my Cavalier King Charles by clipping the length of her ears by 5 centimeters or more. All the aesthetic charm of my dog ​​is destroyed with square ears. She did leave me a tearful message to apologize, but the damage is done and irreparable. I had clearly specified that her coat should not be touched and her fur not to be cut!
Great service and great haircut for both dogs 🐶 …
